thread:
chloe: Heads up - onboarding sample app CI failing when using Python SDK but curl works. Noticed while exercising route update flow.

sam: repro for me too. curl returns 200, SDK gets 422 Unprocessable Entity. Can you paste payloads?

chloe: Python SDK v0.9.7 call: 
```py
client.routes.update('route_123', {
  'name': 'greeting',
  'traffic_split': 0.5,
  'enable_experimental_rerank': True,
})
```
server error: "422: unrecognized parameter: enable_experimental_rerank"

curl used: 
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes/route_123 \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n -d '{"name":"greeting","traffic_split":0.5,"enable_experimental_rerank":true}'
```
works fine.

leo: this smells like the SDK validates request body against an allowlist and strips unknown keys. We made that change a while back to improve typing safety but missed the experimental flag surface.

claire: also noticed the SDK performs automatic retry on 401 by refreshing token; the refresh flow currently retries the original PATCH without injecting an idempotency key, so we see doubled operations in Dedicated sometimes. curl not retrying explains divergence.

sam: two issues then: param filtering and unsafe retry. Quick mitigation ideas?

leo: short term: add a fallback that preserves unknown keys under "_extra" in the serialized body, and emit a warning in the console. Longer term: support passthrough unknown keys and update typings.

chloe: can we have the SDK include an "Idempotency-Key" for mutating endpoints by default? That would avoid duplicates.

ops-bot: Created ticket RDW-1315: "py-sdk strips unknown params + unsafe retry for mutating ops" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-1315 :white_check_mark:

claire: i'll draft a backward-compatible change: 1) generate idempotency key for POST/PATCH/PUT if none provided, 2) allow unknown body fields to pass-through under an extras map, 3) add a feature flag to opt into stricter typing.

leo: i'll open a small patch to the serializer and add unit tests simulating unknown param roundtrip. also will add an integration test in the sampleapp CI that asserts the server receives the experimental flag.

sam: please add a changelog/notice in the quickstart docs about the idempotency header behavior so users know why duplicates shouldn't happen after upgrade.

chloe: thanks all. small DX regressions like this are painful for new users. appreciate quick action. :pray:
